# Vanilla Calendar Pro (vendored)

- Version: 3.4.0 (npm `vanilla-calendar-pro`, the version Bootstrap 6.0.0-alpha.1 requires: `^3.4.0`)
- Source: https://registry.npmjs.org/vanilla-calendar-pro/-/vanilla-calendar-pro-3.4.0.tgz
- License: MIT (see `LICENSE`)
- Files: `index.mjs` (the ES module build). The library's own CSS is not used: Bootstrap 6 styles the calendar
  (`[data-vc=calendar]` in `vendor/bootstrap6/css/bootstrap.css`).

Used by `ui-datepicker` (module `bootstrap`), loaded on first use.
